summary: Lane 07's four-ticket diff (#974, #995, #1009, #998) is exceptionally well-disciplined against this repo's documented standards. Both migrations (0260, 0261) follow the house law precisely: prestate pins measured on the rig (independently re-verified), correct dependency census before the drop in 0261, additive-splice idiom matching direct precedents (0146/0180) in 0260, tail assertions that behaviourally exercise the real doors, and correctly-reasoned omission of a rig-meta cohort/preintegration-gate module in both files with named precedent (0118, 0129, 0146, 0180). TDD vertical-slicing is genuinely followed — each ticket's report documents a real red-before-green cycle (independently spot-checked and reproduced for #974's DB test and the whole #998 gate chain), and #1009's four commits are cleanly sliced one seam at a time. Test quality is high throughout: components are driven through an injected loader (an established seam in this codebase), DB behaviour is proven through real doors (propose/sign/retire_depreciation_authority) rather than raw inserts, and the one e2e cell mocks only the network RPC boundary. Shared files (rig-meta.mjs, package.json's gate chain, test/manifest.txt, firm-scope-db-pins.corpus.ts) are touched with minimal, correctly-sorted hunks per work-order rule 7. Docs (README, CONTEXT.md) are updated or explicitly, correctly left alone with stated reasoning. No PRD/ARCHITECTURE edits, no applied-migration edits, no frozen-workflow touch. The only standards-relevant issue found is a pre-existing, self-acknowledged Duplicated Code smell (not newly introduced, but deepened by one field) — see the single finding below. A pre-existing, unrelated typecheck defect in document-kind-dialog.tsx (predating the wave-2 base commit) blocks e2e builds repo-wide; all three touching reports (974, 995, 998, 1009) correctly diagnosed it, proved it pre-existing and out of scope, and flagged it as a cross-lane follow-up — this is not a lane-07 standards violation.

findings.title: Duplicated Code: FULL_ROW_KEYS review-queue-row key roster is hand-maintained in two files
findings.evidence: packages/db/tests/ninth-rowkind-seeding-proposal.test.mjs:43-46 and packages/db/tests/work-question-reads.test.mjs:52-57 both define an identical FULL_ROW_KEYS array pinning clara.list_review_queue's full row-json key set. #974's commit c7b434584 edits BOTH copies by hand to add 'authority_id' (see needs-you.ts's own 'EXTENSION POINT' comment, which explicitly names this: '#629 restated pin (3) as a second file-local copy rather than importing the first; #974 keeps both in sync, but a future addition should collapse them to one shared const'). This is a Shotgun-Surgery risk for the next row kind: a twelfth addition that updates only one copy would silently desync the two censuses rather than fail loudly.
findings.required_fix: Extract FULL_ROW_KEYS into one shared exported const (e.g. in a small shared test-support module) that both files import, so a future row-kind addition is a single edit instead of two hand-kept copies. Not required for #974's own acceptance — the ticket kept both in sync correctly and this is pre-existing duplication (born at #629) that #974 only deepened by one key — but worth doing before a thirteenth row kind adds a third copy.
findings.note: Already self-identified by the implementer in needs-you.ts's own comment and listed as a follow-up in reports/wave2-lane07-ticket974.md. Reported here per this review's own mandate to name baseline smells in the diff regardless of whether the author already flagged them.
